add_fix_code: Python 3.9-3.13 is generally installed by default on any of our supported Linux distributions, which meets our recommendation.
It is recommended that you use Python 3.9 - 3.13.
Currently, PyTorch on Windows only supports Python 3.9-3.13; Python 2.x is not supported.
